name: Marina Heritage Walk
description: A guided heritage walk along Marina Beach exploring Chennai's colonial and cultural history with expert local historians.

name: AI for Everyone Workshop
description: Hands-on introduction to Artificial Intelligence concepts, tools, and real-world applications — no prior coding experience needed.

name: Sunrise Yoga in the Park
description: Begin your day with a rejuvenating 90-minute outdoor yoga session guided by certified instructors in the calm of Nandanam Park.

name: South Indian Food Carnival
description: A grand culinary celebration featuring 50+ stalls of authentic South Indian cuisine from Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.

name: Carnatic Fusion Night
description: An evening of boundary-pushing Carnatic fusion blending classical ragas with jazz, electronic, and world music elements.

name: Street Art & Mural Fest
description: Watch and participate as local and national artists transform the Mylapore walls into a vibrant open-air gallery of murals and street art.

name: Python Bootcamp
description: Intensive one-day Python bootcamp covering fundamentals, data structures, file handling, and building a mini project from scratch.

name: Zumba & Dance Fitness
description: High-energy Zumba and dance fitness session combining Latin rhythms and Bollywood beats in a fun group workout format.

name: Baking Masterclass
description: Learn artisan bread, croissants, and South Indian fusion pastries from a professional pastry chef with 15 years of experience.

name: Tamil Indie Music Fest
description: A showcase of independent Tamil musicians spanning folk, indie rock, hip-hop, and experimental genres on one historic stage.

name: Kalaignar Cultural Fest
description: A grand celebration of Tamil literature, theatre, classical dance, and folk art with performances by acclaimed artists across genres.

name: Data Science Conclave
description: A full-day conference featuring industry practitioners sharing real-world insights on data science, machine learning, and analytics.
